messages.subject: SPCG | Solar growth, governance and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear SPCG Leadership Team,

SPCG's long-standing solar platform in Thailand is closely aligned with the energy-transition work I support today inside a major industrial operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate includes government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage. I also coordinated carbon-data readiness using physical operating records and lead stakeholder follow-through across environmental, energy and community matters. This gives me direct operating context around the issues that sit behind solar deployment.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across External Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached an SPCG-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
